title: 第1972章 天道之死合体降临第1971章 叶蚯之威投奔天道
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
【清浊分离】就是各方将要争夺的机缘。
陈青玄的感知快速笼罩西洲。
他亲眼目睹了这些“浑浊灵气”带来的影响，心里只希望其归属尽快见分晓，好让一切能够恢复正常。
陈青玄随即望向了“清浊”的分界。
这两者的界限形成了剖面，仿佛是另外一片天地。
陈青玄进入到了“清”的部分。
他很快感受到了不同。
如果说，“浊”的部分是让那些浑浊的灵气取代了原本正常的灵气，进而让整体的修炼环境趋于恶化。
那么“清”的部分就是走了另外一个极端。
这里的灵气全部被提纯过，修士在这里修行和破境，全部都能实现“事半功倍”的效果。
只此一点，两个区域的差距就被拉开了。
那些留在“清”的修士越来越强，留在“浊”的修士越来越弱。
到最后，强者全部向上，弱者全部下沉。
如果抛开自家的因素不谈，陈青玄竟是觉得这样的安排真有几分合理性。
前提是，“清”的生灵不会穿过界限，对“浊”的生灵施加进一步的影响。
双方彻底分离。
陈青玄想到这，不由恍然大悟。
原来这才是【清浊分离】想要表达的理念。
看这架势，如今的界河正在被【清浊分离】重新塑造。
这种直接拨弄整个世界的伟力，当真是凌驾于返虚境之上。

陈青玄同样心生向往。
他尚且如此，那些早就盯上了这道机缘的人更加不可能放弃。
很快，陈青玄就感受到了来自天道的呼唤。
他朝着天道所在的方位赶去。
紧接着，陈青玄的视野范围内就有一颗巨大的眼睛浮现，围绕着这个眼睛便有无数的灵气汇聚成漩涡的形态。
这就是天道的真实模样。
即便陈青玄已经拥有了返虚圆满的实力，他在面对天道的时候，仍然不可避免生出了一种无力感。
只怕，天道的实力已经逼近了合体境。
这要是真的让他突破成功了，从今往后界河的生灵再无翻身的可能。
陈青玄很快收到了天道的指示。
他的脑海中浮现出了一道法门，其作用是聚合“清气”的。
天道让包括他在内的仆从一同聚合清气，以加快天道对“清”的掌控速度。
content_en:
[Separation of clear and turbidity] is the opportunity that all parties will compete for.
Chen Qingxuan's perception quickly enveloped Xizhou.
He had witnessed the impact of these "turbid auras" with his own eyes, and he only hoped that their ownership would be known as soon as possible so that everything could return to normal.
Chen Qingxuan then looked at the boundary between "clear and turbid".
The boundary between the two forms a cross-section, as if it is another world.
Chen Qingxuan entered the "Qing" part.
He quickly felt the difference.
If we say, the "turbid" part is that the turbid spiritual energy replaces the original normal spiritual energy, which in turn worsens the overall cultivation environment.
So the "Qing" part is taken to the other extreme.
All the spiritual energy here has been purified, and monks who practice and break through realms here can achieve the effect of "doing twice the result with half the effort".
With this alone, the gap between the two regions was widened.
Those monks who stayed in "Qing" became stronger and stronger, while the monks who stayed in "turbid" became weaker and weaker.
In the end, the strong will all go up and the weak will all sink.
If his own factors are put aside, Chen Qingxuan actually feels that this arrangement is somewhat reasonable.
The premise is that "clear" creatures will not cross the boundary and exert further influence on "turbid" creatures.
The two sides completely separated.
When Chen Qingxuan thought of this, he suddenly realized.
It turns out that this is the concept that [Separation of Purity and Turbidity] wants to express.
Looking at this situation, today's boundary river is being reshaped by [separation of clear and turbid].
This great power to directly manipulate the entire world is truly superior to the Return to the Void Realm.
Chen Qingxuan is also yearning for it.
Even if he is like this, those who have been eyeing this opportunity for a long time are even less likely to give up.
Soon, Chen Qingxuan felt the call from heaven.
He rushed towards the direction of Tiandao.
Immediately afterwards, a huge eye appeared within Chen Qingxuan's field of vision, and around this eye, countless spiritual energy gathered into the shape of a whirlpool.
This is the true appearance of the way of heaven.
Even though Chen Qingxuan already possesses the strength to return to the void and achieve perfection, he still inevitably feels a sense of powerlessness when facing the way of heaven.
I'm afraid that Tiandao's strength has already approached the Fusion Realm.
If this really allowed him to succeed in breaking through, there would be no possibility for the creatures in Jiehe to turn around from now on.
Chen Qingxuan quickly received Tiandao's instructions.
A method emerged in his mind, the function of which was to gather "clear energy".
Tiandao asked his servants, including him, to gather Qing Qi together to speed up Tiandao's control of "Qing".
